title: TensorUnitOpenDegreeZero
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $y\in Y$, $n\in\mathbf N$, and $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module. Let $P=X_n$ be the formal fibre and $h=i_n:P\to X$ of [def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology]; put $F'=i_n^*F$ using the fixed tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $I$ be an injective resolution of $F$, $J$ a resolution of $F'$, $V\subseteq Y$ open, $U=f^{-1}V$ and $W=i_n^{-1}U$, and let $D$ be FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices for $f$, the formal-fibre base map, $F,I,J,V$ of [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Suppose $P\subseteq W$, so $W=P$. For each $t\in F(U)$ let $s\in\Gamma(U,F|_U)$ correspond to $t$ by restrictAppIso and inclusion-image-top, and let $z\in\Gamma(P,F')$ be the restriction to top of the fixed tensor-adjunction unit image of $t$. The cohomology h-map [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] of $D.\mathrm{psi}$ sends the canonical degree-zero augmentation of $s$ to the restriction-adjunction cohomology map along $W\hookrightarrow P$ applied to the canonical augmentation of $z$. No flatness or properness is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the canonical degree-zero augmentation square to D.psi and to the restriction-adjunction unit on P. This reduces the equality to equality of their resulting sections of F restricted to W.

Evaluate D.unit_square on U and t. Pushforward composition and congruence are the canonical section identifications; the restriction unit acts by restriction. Identify the source section with s by restrictAppIso and inclusion-image-top. Since W=P, restrictions between W and top cancel. Naturality of the tensor unit identifies the other section with the restriction unit applied to z. Apply the common augmentation.

theorem tensorUnit_open_degree_zero {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (y : S) (n : ℕ)
    (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F))
    (V : S.Opens) (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f (formalFibreBaseMap S y n) F I J V)
    (hV : (⊤ : (formalFibre f y n).Opens) ≤ (formalFibreι f y n) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    (t : F.presheaf.obj (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))) :
    moduleCohomologyFMap ((formalFibreι f y n).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      ((formalFibreι f y n) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl) D.psi 0
        (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor
          (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace).toRightDerivedZero.app
            ((restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F)).hom
            ((F.restrictAppIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ⊤).inv
              (F.presheaf.map (eqToHom (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι_image_top).op t))) =
    moduleCohomologyFMap ((formalFibreι f y n) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι
      ((restrictAdjunction ((formalFibreι f y n) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι).unit.app
        ((tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F)) 0
          (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor
            (formalFibre f y n).toRingedSpace).toRightDerivedZero.app
              ((tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F)).hom
              (((tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE hV).op
                  ((((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
                    (formalFibreι f y n))).unit.app F).val.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))).hom t)))
